meta.source: Real Telecom Italia Milan traffic (held-out test day) on the central 10x10 grid block, scripted events, calibrated QoS model (src/unified).

events.label: mMTC storm
events.description: Thousands of smart meters report at once: mMTC demand x8 for 30 minutes.

events.label: Interference spike
events.description: External interference triples inter-cell coupling, so each cell's usable capacity drops.

events.label: Cell outage
events.description: A cell goes dark. 70% of its users re-attach to the four neighbours; the rest lose service.

events.label: Backhaul degradation
events.description: A backhaul fault halves one cell's capacity for two hours.

events.label: Flash crowd
events.description: An evening event draws a crowd: eMBB x3, URLLC x1.8 across 13 cells.

events.label: URLLC burst
events.description: Emergency-services traffic: URLLC x5 on two cells.

reactive.label: Reactive
reactive.description: Expert rules on the demand it sees now

predictive.label: Predictive
predictive.description: Same rules, fed the TGNN forecast of the next 10 minutes
